caveats: Results are associations, not proof of cause.
Rates cover only trains recorded in National Rail's Historical Service Performance data; trains it did not record are not counted.
The data covers 10 weekdays (5 to 16 October 2026), so figures can move with more data.
A train counts as failed if it was 5 or more minutes late or was cancelled.
Metrolink trams and buses are not included.
A station's reliability depends partly on its line and position on the network, which the expected rate accounts for only approximately.
Only 11 trains were recorded, so these figures are uncertain.
Few neighbourhoods lie within 1.5 km of this station, so its deprivation figure is uncertain.
